text: We are hiring a Systems Administrator to support our corporate IT environment of about 400 users. You will manage Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, keep Microsoft Exchange and VMware hosts healthy, and handle backup and disaster recovery. You will also maintain SQL Server databases, resolve escalated help desk tickets, and support LAN/WAN connectivity across three offices. Requirements: at least 3 years of experience as a systems or network administrator, hands-on Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware and SQL Server, and working knowledge of PowerShell for automation. This is a mid-level role reporting to the IT Manager. Clear communication with non-technical staff is important.

Our manufacturing plant is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to lead design and process improvement projects for industrial filtration equipment. You will create and review 3D models and drawings in SolidWorks and AutoCAD, run design calculations, and support fabrication and welding teams on the shop floor. You will drive root cause analysis, SPC and Lean initiatives to reduce scrap and cost. Requirements: BS in Mechanical Engineering, minimum 7 years of product design or manufacturing engineering experience, strong SolidWorks and AutoCAD skills, experience with Six Sigma tools and project management. This is a senior position that mentors two engineers.

We need a Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. You will lead budgeting and forecasting for the annual plan and monthly outlook, run variance analysis against actuals, and prepare management reports for department heads. You will do financial modeling for capital investments and pricing decisions, and work with accounting during month-end close. Requirements: degree in Finance or Economics, 2+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, advanced Excel including pivot tables, experience with Hyperion or a similar planning tool, and comfort presenting to leadership. This is a mid-level role.

A growing distribution company is hiring a Staff Accountant. You will own accounts payable and accounts receivable, post journal entries, perform monthly bank reconciliations and support the month-end close of the general ledger. You will also help with payroll processing, sales tax filings and year-end audit schedules. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, minimum 2 years of accounting experience, solid knowledge of GAAP, hands-on QuickBooks and Excel. Experience with Great Plains is a plus. This is a junior role, and we offer CPA exam support.

Our community bank is looking for a Personal Banker for a busy branch. You will handle account opening for new deposit customers, process consumer loans, and cross-sell bank products to meet monthly sales goals. You will handle cash transactions, balance your cash drawer, and follow BSA/AML and KYC compliance procedures. Strong customer service and the ability to build long-term client relationships are essential. Requirements: 1+ year of experience as a teller or in retail banking, cash handling accuracy, Microsoft Office, and a positive attitude. This is a junior position with a clear path to Assistant Branch Manager.

An upscale hotel restaurant is hiring an Executive Chef to lead a kitchen team of 25. You will own menu development and recipe development for seasonal menus, and lead food cost control and labor cost control against budget. You will manage purchasing, receiving and inventory, and make sure the kitchen follows HACCP and ServSafe sanitation standards. You will also run banquets and catering events for up to 400 guests. Requirements: culinary degree or equivalent, at least 8 years of progressive kitchen experience with 3 years as Sous Chef or higher, strong P&L management, and staff training skills. Senior level.

A multi-specialty clinic is looking for a Healthcare Practice Manager. You will supervise front office and clinical support staff, manage scheduling, and oversee medical billing and coding using ICD-10 and CPT codes. You will handle insurance verification, Medicare and Medicaid claims, and keep the practice compliant with HIPAA. You will also track budgets and patient satisfaction. Requirements: at least 5 years of healthcare administration experience, working knowledge of EMR systems, medical terminology and Microsoft Excel, and proven staff leadership. Senior level.

We are seeking a Graphic Designer to create print and digital marketing materials for our retail brand. You will design brochures, packaging, signage and social media graphics, handle print production, and keep everything consistent with our brand guidelines. You will work closely with the marketing team and present concepts to stakeholders. Requirements: portfolio required, 2+ years of design experience, expert in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, strong typography and layout skills. Basic HTML is a plus. This is a mid-level role.

Our agency is hiring a Digital Marketing Specialist to grow organic and paid traffic for B2C clients. You will run SEO audits, do keyword research, manage PPC campaigns in Google AdWords, and report results in Google Analytics. You will also drive content marketing, plan content calendars, write web copy, and manage client social media on Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn. Requirements: 3+ years of digital marketing experience, hands-on SEO and PPC, experience with a CMS such as WordPress, basic HTML/CSS, and strong writing skills. Mid level.

A B2B technology services company is hiring an Outside Sales Representative. You will prospect new accounts through cold calling and networking, run product presentations, negotiate pricing and close multi-year contracts. You will own pipeline management in Salesforce and meet monthly revenue quotas. Strong relationship building and follow-up after the sale are key. Requirements: 2+ years of B2B sales experience with a proven record of hitting quota, solid negotiation and presentation skills, and Microsoft Office. Mid-level role with base salary plus commission.

We are looking for a Senior Finance Manager to oversee financial reporting and controls for a regional company. You will lead the monthly close, review general ledger reconciliations, and prepare financial statements under GAAP and IFRS. You will manage the annual budget and cash flow forecasts, coordinate external audits, and monitor debt covenants with our banks. Requirements: CPA or CMA preferred, at least 8 years of progressive finance or accounting experience, strong knowledge of SAP ERP and Excel, and experience managing a small team. Senior level.

A regional bank is hiring a Loan Operations Specialist for its back office. You will handle loan processing for consumer and commercial files, verify documentation, and perform daily general ledger reconciliations for loan accounts. You will prepare reports on delinquent accounts, support collections, and help with internal audits and regulatory compliance. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in banking operations or lending, strong attention to detail, knowledge of reconciliations and compliance, and Microsoft Excel. Experience with a core banking system such as Hogan is a plus. Mid level.

We are hiring a UX/UI Designer to improve our customer-facing web and mobile applications. You will run user research and usability testing, build personas and user flows, and turn findings into wireframes and interactive prototypes. You will create visual designs and work with developers in an Agile team. Requirements: 5+ years of user centered design experience, strong skills in Photoshop and Illustrator, prototyping tools, and working knowledge of HTML and CSS. You should be comfortable presenting design decisions to product owners. Senior level.

Our media company is looking for a Digital Content Producer to create visual content for our websites and social channels. You will design web graphics in Photoshop and Illustrator, do video editing for short clips, and publish content through our CMS. You will manage social media posting schedules, track engagement with Google Analytics, and work with designers and writers on campaigns. Requirements: 1+ year of experience in digital media or content production, portfolio of web and video work, basic HTML, and strong communication skills. This is a junior role.

An industrial automation firm is hiring a Controls Engineer. You will design and program control systems for manufacturing lines, write PLC logic, and develop HMI screens. You will collect production data into SQL databases, analyze it with MATLAB, and support commissioning and troubleshooting on site. You will also prepare electrical drawings in AutoCAD. Requirements: BS in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, at least 4 years of controls or automation experience, PLC programming, SQL, MATLAB and AutoCAD, and willingness to travel 25%. Mid level.
